question.worked_solution:
Here, we have the product of two functions $u(x)={3}^{x}$ and $v(x)=\operatorname{cos}⁡(x).$ So, we apply the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & ={({3}^{x})}^{′}\operatorname{cos}⁡(x)+{3}^{x}{(\operatorname{cos}⁡(x))}^{′} \\  & =({3}^{x}\operatorname{ln}⁡(3))\operatorname{cos}⁡(x)+{3}^{x}(-\operatorname{sin}⁡(x)) \\  & ={3}^{x}\operatorname{ln}⁡(3)\operatorname{cos}⁡(x)-{3}^{x}\operatorname{sin}⁡(x)\end{aligned}
$$
